 Automated text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus confirms these connections, identifying an almost exact verse quotation between segments §2.1–2.4 of this text and the *Muni Sutta* (Snp 1.12 §1.1–1.4, similarity 0.99), a passage which also reappears in Mil 7.4.4 (§6.1–6.4) [DharmaNexus]. A low-scoring cross-language match is also noted with the Tibetan translation of the *Jātakamālā* (D4150) [DharmaNexus].
